title: Threat Intel in Right Click
description: 4NTL is a browser extension for Chromium-based browsers that enables quick threat intelligence lookups from the right-click menu. It allows users to check IPs, domains, URLs, or file hashes against VirusTotal and AbuseIPDB without leaving the current page. The extension is designed to improve analyst efficiency by reducing the need to copy and paste indicators into separate tabs. It respects user privacy by only querying VirusTotal and AbuseIPDB, never submitting new samples, and keeping API keys local to the browser profile. No active exploitation or vulnerabilities are reported in the extension itself.
